issue_templates.name: Bug Report
issue_templates.content:
## Bug Report

### Description
Brief description of the bug.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

### Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

### Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots.

### Environment
- Platform: [e.g. OpenDiscourse v1.1.0]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox]
- Database: [e.g. PostgreSQL 15]

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem.

### Labels
- bug
- needs-triage
